environment.WREN_QUERY_TEST_DATABASE_URL: Supplied to same private PG for six original migration/conditional-binding tests.

previous_conditional_cases: refuses unprovable legacy rows without deleting them or inventing a project
backfills only matching original thread evidence and requires ownership for new rows
serializes concurrent first bindings and rejects foreign project or stale query receipts
rolls back speculative native rows when a conditional binding fails
permits empty rollback then forward migration only after evidence is absent
retains running/unknown task evidence across every native cascade and permits observed terminal cleanup
serializes a delayed task writer with the original PostgreSQL project fence

first-binding.mutation: Remove original bindResponse null-or-same-target conditional update guard.
assertions: Concurrent first bindings accepted 2 instead of 1.

closed-generation.mutation: Disable rejection when persisted project fence generation closes this binding.
closed-generation.assertion: Delayed writer resolved instead of NATIVE_BINDING_CLOSED rejection.

scope: All four original files ran without test-name filtering in the normal check; all seven previous PostgreSQL conditional skips executed.
